customManagers.description: This repository pins the agentdev catalog in .claude/settings.json; bump it when a new marketplace release is tagged.

packageRules.description: Automatically merge GitHub Actions dependency updates after Renovate observes green CI.
agent-desktop is published by plume-works/agent-devcontainer, not built here, so a digest bump is an external change and gets a normal review rather than automerge. The pin lives in compose.pins.yml.
